verify-313.summary: Verified #313 against main HEAD (post-#304, 0257903), zero issue comments. All six asks confirmed from source with file:line evidence. Convert's wire shape needs only editor tier (series CREATE + _parent APPEND, no delete) — the #304 owner-tier addition (isOwnerTier) is for UNASSIGN only and is NOT what convert should reuse; convert can reuse the page's existing isEditor. Sweep found 3 spec files touching the removal set: page.event-convert.spec.ts (entirely RELOCATES — its whole 1170-line contract targets the panel's convert entry point), page.season-manage-delete.spec.ts (mixed: several event-row-only tests DIE outright, several combined series+event assertions MODIFY, series-only assertions SURVIVE), page.season-repertoire.spec.ts (one test uses standalone-event-delete purely as a cheap reload trigger — DIES as written, needs a substitute trigger, e.g. series delete). No Playwright/E2E suite exists in the repo (none found), so no cross-page flow risk beyond these three files.

findings.claim: (1) The season panel's standalone-events section, its two controls, and their state/handlers
findings.evidence: src/routes/+page.svelte (main HEAD): the 'standalone events' block runs from the comment at 7028 to closing `` at 7305, inside the season-manage panel. Row markup: `data-testid="season-manage-event-{event.id}"` (7065). Two controls per row: CONVERT — `season-manage-event-convert-{event.id}` (7090-7098), `aria-label={m.season_manage_event_convert(...)}` (7091), `onclick={() => openEventConvertForm(event)}` (7096); DELETE — armed pair `season-manage-event-delete-confirm-{event.id}`/`-cancel-{event.id}` (7101,7114) plus the trigger `DeleteTrigger` `season-manage-event-delete-{event.id}` (7129) wired to `armSeasonManageDelete`. State declared ONLY for this list: `seasonManageEvents` ($state, 2621) and `seasonManageEventsError` ($state, 2629) — both fetched/reset at 2901-2903, 3024, 3058-3064, 3819-3828, filtered on delete at 4109. Handler serving ONLY this list: `onSeasonManageEventDelete(event)` (4099-4119) — calls `apiDeleteEvent(cfg, event.id)`, filters `seasonManageEvents`, sets `seasonManageDeleteStatus`, calls `refreshAfterSeasonManageDelete(cfg)`. `submitEventConvert` (4342-4569): `if (eventConvertSubmitting) return; if (!selected || manageableSeasonId === null) return;` (4344) — depends on `manageableSeasonId`, the PANEL's season-scoped id. Rights guard for the whole panel: `showSeasonCard`/`manageableSeasonRights === 'editor'` (2609-2612) — editor tier on the SEASON, not owner. Removal set (serves ONLY this list): `seasonManageEvents`, `seasonManageEventsError`, `onSeasonManageEventDelete`, the row markup, and the `'events'` arm of `seasonManageDeleteError.list`/`seasonManageDeleteFailure('events', …)`. NOT in the removal set (shared with series rows, survive): `seasonManageDeleteArmed`, `seasonManageArmedSeriesCount`, `seasonManageDeletePendingId`, `seasonManageDeleteStatus`, `seasonManageDeleteProgress`, `seasonManageDeleteGeneration`, `armSeasonManageDelete`/`disarmSeasonManageDelete`, `refreshAfterSeasonManageDelete`. The eventConvert-* state/handlers relocate to the event page rather than being deleted.

findings.claim: (2) Where convert would sit relative to #304's new series-picker region; what rights resolution #304 added; whether convert can reuse it; how the page knows STANDALONE
findings.evidence: src/routes/event/[id]/+page.svelte (main HEAD): the #304 series picker is a div gated `{#if isEditor && detail.seasonId !== null && seriesOptionsLoaded}` (2509), placed FIRST inside the `{#if detail}` header block (comment 2502-2508: 'Placed FIRST in the header'). #304 added `isOwnerTier` (386-398, quoted): '#304 — SPECIFICALLY owner-tier (not merely `_editor`), off the SAME `ownerIds` the tally/isEditor rule already reads. UNASSIGN (a `_parent` value DELETE) is owner-gated on the wire ... an `_editor`-only viewer gets a 403.' `const isOwnerTier = $derived(detail !== null && selected !== null && detail.ownerIds.includes(selected.personId));` (396-398), feeding `seriesUnassignGated` (403-410). This gate is SPECIFIC to the DELETE-shaped unassign op. Convert can NOT reuse `isOwnerTier`/`seriesUnassignGated` — its writes (series CREATE + `_parent` APPEND, see finding 3) are editor-reachable, matching `isEditor` (369-378) which the page already computes with no extra fetch, and matching the panel's current convert gate (`manageableSeasonRights === 'editor'`). Standalone detection: `EventDetail.seriesId` (src/lib/events/eventDetail.ts:95, string|null), derived at 233: `const seriesId = parents.find((p) => p.entity_type === 'event_series')?.reference ?? null;` — null exactly when standalone. A convert control would naturally sit adjacent to/inside the series-picker region, shown only when `detail.seriesId === null`, but exact placement is an implementation choice #304's code does not reserve a slot for.

findings.claim: (3) Convert's wire shape and rights tiers per operation; confirms no _parent DELETE, so owner-gate should not bite
findings.evidence: src/lib/events/eventConvert.ts (main HEAD): step 2 `create-series` calls `createEventSeries` parented to `[dbEntityId, seasonId]` — a plain CREATE, editor-reachable. Step 3 `link-event`: 'POST entity/{eventId} — ONE new `_parent` { reference: <the new series> }. The event's existing db + season `_parent` values are NEVER touched' (lines 26-30) — an APPEND, not a delete/replace. #304's own probe (mirrored in isOwnerTier's doc, +page.svelte:388-390) states: 'REASSIGN (the atomic-overwrite POST) is editor-reachable' — the same operation family as convert's link-event append. Step 4 `delete-name` DELETEs the event's own name property VALUES (not `_parent`), unrelated to the owner-gated `_parent`-value-DELETE the probe found. Convert never deletes a `_parent` value — the season parent stays untouched throughout (eventConvert.ts:28-30) — so the owner-gate found for UNASSIGN does not apply to convert. Net: series CREATE = editor tier; `_parent` append = editor tier; name-value DELETE = ordinary property delete, not the `_parent`-specific owner gate. Convert should stay gated on `isEditor`, not `isOwnerTier`.

findings.evidence: messages/en.json:494 "Repeating? Pick or create a series above — or convert this event to one later from the season panel." messages/et.json:494 "Kordub? Оберіть або створіть серію вище — або перетворіть цю подію на серію пізніше з панелі сезону." All four explicitly name 'the season panel'. Renders at src/routes/+page.svelte:7652 `{m.event_create_series_hint()}`, inside `{#if eventCreateSeriesId === ''}` (7645) — inside the season panel's event-CREATE form, not the event page. Comment 7644-7649: 'the panel's per-row convert control (#196 phase 2) exists for exactly that' — must be rewritten to point at wherever convert lands, in all four locales.

findings.claim: (5) The sweep of every spec/text reference to the four removal-set identifiers, and which specs die/relocate/pass-through
findings.evidence: git grep on main for `season-manage-event-convert-*` / `season-manage-event-delete-*` / `seasonManageEvents` / `submitEventConvert` hits: src/routes/+page.svelte (implementation), src/lib/events/eventConvert.ts (doc comment only), and three spec files. (a) src/routes/page.event-convert.spec.ts — RELOCATES WHOLESALE: 1170+ lines, header doc frames it as testing conversion 'on the ACTUAL agenda route', drives entry via `season-manage-event-convert-ev-9` (15 raw hits: 65,362,422,902,920,946,1048-1070 etc.) rendered through +page.svelte's season panel. Behavior (validation/occurrence-loop/resume/dialog/locale-parity, describe blocks at 416,622,821,880,910,993,1025,1097,1143) survives the move but the DOM entry point/route must relocate to the event page. The phase-1 hint tests (378-410) and locale non-emptiness checks (1097-1141) SURVIVE unchanged (paraglide mock echoes keys, not literal text; the #212 'Starts'/'Algus' pin at 1158-1163 is unrelated). (b) src/routes/page.season-manage-delete.spec.ts — MIXED, 22 raw hits: DIES — 'a standalone event's delete calls deleteEvent...' (491-506), both #212 'opening convert disarms armed delete' tests (938-1010, premised on convert living in-panel), the NON-editor absence check for `season-manage-event-delete-*` (454-461). MODIFIES — render/accessible-name test (426-451, drop 441-448), series-delete-survives test (468-487, drop line 486), `armAndConfirmDelete(container,'event',...)` calls (497,523,566,815,870,914) whose 'event' branch dies while 'series' branch survives, and the 'ONE armed context' test (1245-1267) mixing a surviving series-arm assertion with a dying event-row-arm assertion (1259-1266). Season-delete-only blocks (1127+) are unrelated and untouched. (c) src/routes/page.season-repertoire.spec.ts — one block (996-1006): test at 971 uses standalone-event delete purely as 'the cheapest such reload' (comment 960-969 lists equivalent alternatives) to exercise panel-preserving reload — DIES as written, should relocate to a surviving trigger (e.g. series delete). No other file (docs, e2e, Playwright) references these identifiers; no e2e/Playwright directory exists in the tree at all.

findings.claim: (6) Never-a-window check: does anything else (doc/E2E/Playwright flow) walk season-panel to convert and risk breaking mid-slice
findings.evidence: Repo-wide tree listing found no e2e/ or playwright/ directory and no product-doc *.md referencing this flow (only internal team-memory notes, out of scope). The only three surfaces walking season-panel→convert are the spec files in finding (5), all ordinary Vitest specs in the same package as +page.svelte — no separate deploy boundary exists that could observe an in-between state, so a single squash-merged commit landing the event-page convert control, the panel removal, and the spec relocations together closes the window atomically. One residual risk: if page.season-repertoire.spec.ts's reload test (finding 5c) is simply deleted rather than re-pointed at a surviving trigger, the panel-preserving-reload behavior (`refreshAfterSeasonManageDelete` keeping `season-manage-panel` open across a write-triggered reload) loses its only coverage — worth flagging to the implementer, though not itself a shipped-feature break.
